description: Baseline results of the original Predictive Analytics group project, captured from the saved cell outputs of the group notebook Predictive_Final_Project_code.ipynb (6 d.p.; the project paper reports the same values rounded to 3 d.p.). Neither file is included in this repository; baseline/replay_notebook.py re-runs the notebook's code and reproduces these values.
baseline_project: Predicting PM2.5 Air Quality Exceedances Using Machine Learning: A Co-Pollutant Chemistry Approach (Grino, Perez, Valerio)

baseline_environment.libraries: not recorded by the original project

target: air_quality = Unhealthy if station-day mean PM2.5 > 15.0 ug/m3 else Safe

cross_validation.method: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over all model-ready rows

metric_definitions.test_accuracy: sklearn accuracy_score on the held-out test set
metric_definitions.test_precision_weighted: sklearn precision_score(average='weighted', zero_division=0) on the test set
metric_definitions.test_recall_weighted: sklearn recall_score(average='weighted', zero_division=0) on the test set
metric_definitions.test_f1_weighted: sklearn f1_score(average='weighted', zero_division=0) on the test set
metric_definitions.cv_f1_weighted_mean: mean of cross_val_score(..., scoring='f1_weighted') over 5 stratified folds
metric_definitions.cv_f1_weighted_std: population std (numpy default) of the 5 fold scores
metric_definitions.test_true_safe: confusion-matrix count of Safe test rows predicted Safe (reported in the paper)
